description: Intent i008 (branch=nested-parse-null-arg, snapshot=s02) complete. FINDING (high confidence): drivers/net/ieee802154/mac802154_hwsim.c:421-426, hwsim_new_edge_nl (doit for MAC802154_HWSIM_CMD_NEW_EDGE, .flags = GENL_UNS_ADMIN_PERM at line 609, .validate = GENL_DONT_VALIDATE_STRICT at 607). Untrusted source: attacker-crafted generic-netlink attribute set. Violated invariant: presence guard 'if (!info->attrs[MAC802154_HWSIM_ATTR_RADIO_ID] && !info->attrs[MAC802154_HWSIM_ATTR_RADIO_EDGE]) return -EINVAL;' (lines 421-423) joins two negated presence tests with && instead of ||, so a message that supplies RADIO_ID but omits RADIO_EDGE passes validation while info->attrs[MAC802154_HWSIM_ATTR_RADIO_EDGE] stays NULL; hwsim_genl_policy (579-583) declares RADIO_EDGE as plain { .type = NLA_NESTED } with no required marker, so genl core does not reject its absence. Unsafe use: the NULL slot is passed directly as the nesting attribute to nla_parse_nested_deprecated at line 425, which (include/net/netlink.h:1226-1233) calls nla_data(nla)=(char*)nla+NLA_HDRLEN and nla_len(nla)=nla->nla_len-NLA_HDRLEN (1137-1149) on it -> kernel NULL-pointer dereference oops (local DoS). Second independent gap in the same handler: line 431 nla_get_u32(info->attrs[MAC802154_HWSIM_ATTR_RADIO_ID]) is unguarded, so omitting RADIO_ID while supplying RADIO_EDGE also NULL-derefs. Counterevidence: the sibling handlers hwsim_del_edge_nl (483-485) and hwsim_set_edge_lqi (531-533) in this same file already carry the corrected || guard, i.e. the seed fix landed for them but NOT for hwsim_new_edge_nl — the exact variant relationship this intent targets (seed instance itself not reported). Verified safe in s02 (direct-indexed nested parse/for_each sites, guards read): nl802154.c:1565/1617/1794/1928/1962 plus llsec helpers (1298/1338), macsec.c parse_sa/rxsc_config (1667-1681), ip_vs_ctl.c:3655, act_api.c:1605, tipc udp_media.c:684, nl80211.c mesh 7451-7452/7589-7590, netlabel_cipso_v4.c TAGLST/MLSLVLLST/MLSCATLST callers, nfc netlink.c:1166 (guard 1140-1142), sch_mqprio 191/207 inside tb[] ifs, vlan_netlink.c:35 (!attr return 0), cls_flower.c:1269 (caller-guarded 1699), sch_ets 518/557 (caller-guarded 627/634), wireguard 459/584, nbd 1941 (guard 1926/2107), br_mrp/br_cfm dispatchers, dcbnl ieee 1438/1546 (guard 1433/1543), ovs meter.c:342, nf_conntrack_netlink 1266/1312, nft_tunnel.c:361. Bounded negative evidence: 336 nested helper call sites grepped in net/ drivers/ fs/ kernel/; every site whose nesting attribute is directly indexed from info->attrs[]/tb[]/attrs[] was read with its guard. Limitations: sites passing the nesting attribute through intermediate locals/parameters (nf_tables_api.c expression/element lists 3346/4431/5261/5782/6032/6297, openvswitch flow_netlink.c actions, ip_tunnel_core.c, seg6_local.c, nexthop.c, lwt_bpf.c, pmsr.c, team.c, qeth, devlink, drbd_nla.c) were only spot-checked and remain unresolved; no compilation/reproducer run (read-only tree), NULL-deref conclusion rests on reading the inline helper bodies; reachability asserted from GENL_UNS_ADMIN_PERM (userns CAP_NET_ADMIN) and module load is deployment-dependent; impact characterized as local DoS, no privilege escalation demonstrated.
